dn10:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme aciraparinibbute bhagavati.
dn10:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena subho māṇavo todeyyaputto sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati kenacideva karaṇīyena.

dn10:1.2.2: ehi tvaṃ māṇavaka, yena samaṇo ānando tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ ānandaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha
dn10:1.2.3: “subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhavantaṃ ānandaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī”ti.
dn10:1.3.1: “sādhu kira bhavaṃ ānando yena subhassa māṇavassa todeyyaputtassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
dn10:1.3.2: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho so māṇavako subhassa māṇavassa todeyyaputtassa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
dn10:1.3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so māṇavako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn10:1.3.4: subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhavantaṃ ānandaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
dn10:1.3.6: “sādhu kira bhavaṃ ānando yena subhassa māṇavassa todeyyaputtassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.

dn10:1.4.6: “avocumha kho mayaṃ bhoto vacanena taṃ bhavantaṃ ānandaṃ:
dn10:1.4.7: subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhavantaṃ ānandaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati. evaṃ ca vadeti
dn10:1.4.8: ‘sādhu kira bhavaṃ ānando yena subhassa māṇavassa todeyyaputtassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’ti.

dn10:1.4.12: appeva nāma svepi upasaṅkameyyāma kālañca samayañca upādāyā”ti.
dn10:1.4.13: “ettāvatāpi kho bho katameva etaṃ, yato so bho bhavaṃ ānando okāsamakāsi svātanāyapi upasaṅkamanāyā”ti.
dn10:1.5.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya cetakena bhikkhunā pacchāsamaṇena yena subhassa māṇavassa todeyyaputtassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. atha kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
dn10:1.5.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn10:1.5.3: “bhavaṃ hi ānando tassa bhoto gotamassa dīgharattaṃ upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpacārī.
dn10:1.5.4: bhavaṃ etaṃ ānando jāneyya yesaṃ so bhavaṃ gotamo dhammānaṃ vaṇṇavādī ahosi, yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesi.
dn10:1.5.5: katamesānaṃ kho bho ānanda dhammānaṃ so bhavaṃ gotamo vaṇṇavādī ahosi? kattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesī?” ti.
dn10:1.6.1: “tiṇṇaṃ kho māṇava khandhānaṃ so bhagavā vaṇṇavādī ahosi. ettha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesi.
dn10:1.6.3: ariyassa sīlakkhandhassa, ariyassa samādhikkhandhassa, ariyassa paññākkhandhassa.
dn10:1.6.4: imesaṃ kho māṇava tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ so bhagavā vaṇṇavādī ahosi. ettha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesī”ti.

dn10:1.7.1: “idha māṇava, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.

dn10:1.29.1: sa kho so māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.
dn10:1.29.2: seyyathāpi māṇava khattiyo muddhāvasitto nihatapaccāmitto na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati yadidaṃ paccatthikato,
dn10:1.29.3: evameva kho māṇava bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.
dn10:1.29.4: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
dn10:1.29.5: evaṃ kho māṇava bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
dn10:1.30.1: ayaṃ kho so māṇava, ariyo sīlakkhandho yassa so bhagavā vaṇṇavādī ahosi, yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesi.
dn10:1.30.4: so’pāyaṃ bho ānanda ariyo sīlakkhandho paripuṇṇo, no aparipuṇṇo.
dn10:1.30.5: evamparipuṇṇañcāhambho ānanda ariyaṃ sīlakkhandhaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu na samanupassāmi.
dn10:1.30.6: evamparipuṇṇañca bho ānanda ariyaṃ sīlakkhandhaṃ ito bahiddhā aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇā attani samanupasseyyuṃ, te tāvatakeneva attamanā assu
dn10:1.30.7: ‘alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññattho, natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīya’nti.
dn10:1.30.8: atha ca pana bhavaṃ ānando evamāha:
dn10:2.1.1: “katamo pana so bho ānanda, ariyo samādhikkhandho yassa so bhavaṃ gotamo vaṇṇavādī ahosi yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesī?”ti.
dn10:2.2.1: kathañca māṇava, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti?
dn10:2.2.2: idha māṇava bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
dn10:2.2.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati. rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ. cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn10:2.2.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
dn10:2.2.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati. rakkhati manindriyaṃ. manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn10:2.2.10: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
dn10:2.2.11: evaṃ kho māṇava bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
dn10:2.3.1: kathañca māṇava, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti?
dn10:2.3.2: idha māṇava bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti. ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti. sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti. saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti. asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti. uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti. gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
dn10:2.3.3: evaṃ kho māṇava, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti.
dn10:2.4.2: idha māṇava bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihāriyena cīvarena kucchiparihāriyena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
dn10:2.4.3: seyyathāpi māṇava, pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti sapattabhāro’va ḍeti,
dn10:2.4.4: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihāriyena cīvarena kucchiparihāriyena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
dn10:2.4.5: evaṃ kho māṇava bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti.
dn10:2.5.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato
dn10:2.5.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
dn10:2.5.3: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
dn10:2.6.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn10:2.6.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī. byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn10:2.6.3: thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathinamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno. thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn10:2.6.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto. uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn10:2.6.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu. vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn10:2.7.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojeyya,
dn10:2.7.3: so yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantīkareyya, siyā cassa uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāya,
dn10:2.7.5: “ahaṃ kho pubbe iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojesiṃ.
dn10:2.7.7: so’haṃ yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantī akāsiṃ. atthi ca me uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāyā”ti.
dn10:2.7.8: so tato nidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn10:2.8.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno, bhattaṃ cassa nacchādeyya, na cassa kāye balamattā,
dn10:2.8.2: so aparena samayena tamhā ābādhā mucceyya, bhattañcassa chādeyya, siyā cassa kāye balamattā,
dn10:2.8.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe ābādhiko ahosiṃ dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. bhattaṃ ca me nacchādesi. na cassa me āsi kāye balamattā.
dn10:2.8.5: so’mhi etarahi tamhā ābādhā mutto. bhattañca me chādeti. atthi ca me kāye balamattā”ti.
dn10:2.8.6: so tato nidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn10:2.9.1: seyyathāpi māṇava puriso bandhanāgāre baddho assa,
dn10:2.9.2: so aparena samayena tamhā bandhanāgārā mucceyya sotthinā abbayena, na cassa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo,
dn10:2.9.5: so’mhi etarahi tamhā bandhanāgārā mutto sotthinā abbayena. natthi ca me kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo”ti.
dn10:2.9.6: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn10:2.10.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso dāso assa anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo,
dn10:2.10.2: so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamo,
dn10:2.10.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe dāso ahosiṃ anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo.
dn10:2.10.5: so’mhi etarahi tamhā dāsabyā mutto attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamo”ti.
dn10:2.10.6: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn10:2.11.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ,
dn10:2.11.2: so aparena samayena taṃ kantāraṃ nitthareyya, sotthinā gāmantaṃ anupāpuṇeyya khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ,
dn10:2.11.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ.
dn10:2.11.5: so’mhi etarahi taṃ kantāraṃ tiṇṇo sotthinā gāmantaṃ anuppatto khemaṃ appaṭibhaya”nti.
dn10:2.11.6: so tato nidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn10:2.12.1: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu yathā iṇaṃ yathā rogaṃ yathā bandhanāgāraṃ yathā dāsabyaṃ yathā kantāraddhānamaggaṃ, evaṃ ime pañca nīvaraṇe appahīṇe attani samanupassati.
dn10:2.12.2: seyyathāpi māṇava yathā ānaṇyaṃ, yathā ārogyaṃ, yathā bandhanā mokkhaṃ, yathā bhujissaṃ, yathā khemantabhūmiṃ,
dn10:2.12.3: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīṇe attani samanupassati.
dn10:2.12.4: tassime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīṇe attani samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati. pamuditassa pīti jāyati. pītimanassa kāyo passambhati. passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti. sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
dn10:2.13.1: so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn10:2.13.2: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.14.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sāyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena, na ca paggharaṇī,
dn10:2.14.2: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.14.3: yampi māṇava, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
dn10:2.14.4: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti,
dn10:2.15.1: puna caparaṃ māṇava, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn10:2.15.2: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.16.1: seyyathāpi māṇava udakarahado gambhīro ubbhidodako. tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya, atha kho tamhāva udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisandeyya parisandeyya paripūreyya paripphareyya, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa vārinā sītena apphuṭaṃ assa.
dn10:2.16.2: evameva kho māṇava bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.16.3: yampi māṇava, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
dn10:2.16.4: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.17.1: puna caparaṃ māṇava, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti’, taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn10:2.17.2: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.17.3: seyyathāpi māṇava, uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, tāni yāva caggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhissannāni parissannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni, nāssa kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa,
dn10:2.17.4: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.17.5: yampi māṇava, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn10:2.17.6: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti,
dn10:2.18.1: puna caparaṃ māṇava, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn10:2.18.2: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti.
dn10:2.18.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.18.4: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa,
dn10:2.18.5: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn10:2.18.6: yampi māṇava, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
dn10:2.18.7: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti,
dn10:2.19.1: ayaṃ kho so māṇava, ariyo samādhikkhandho yassa so bhagavā vaṇṇavādī ahosi, yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesi.
dn10:2.19.4: so cāyaṃ bho ānanda ariyo samādhikkhandho paripuṇṇo no aparipuṇṇo.
dn10:2.19.5: evaṃ paripuṇṇañcāhaṃ bho ānanda ariyaṃ samādhikkhandhaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu na samanupassāmi.
dn10:2.19.6: evaṃ paripuṇṇañca bho ānanda ariyaṃ samādhikkhandhaṃ ito bahiddhā aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇā attani samanupasseyyuṃ, te tāvatakeneva attamanā assu
dn10:2.19.7: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññattho, natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti.
dn10:2.19.8: atha ca pana bhavaṃ ānando evamāha:
dn10:2.20.1: katamo pana so bho ānanda ariyo paññākkhandho, yassa so bhavaṃ gotamo vaṇṇavādī ahosi yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesī?”ti. “puna caparaṃ māṇava,
dn10:2.21.1: so bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.21.3: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo.
dn10:2.21.4: idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhanti.

dn10:2.22.2: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya: ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno. tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā”ti.
dn10:2.22.3: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

dn10:2.23.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.23.2: so imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn10:2.24.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso muñjamhā isikaṃ pavāheyya.
dn10:2.24.3: ayaṃ muñjo ayaṃ isikā. añño muñjo aññā isikā. muñjamhā tveva isikā pabāḷhā’ti.
dn10:2.24.4: seyyathāpi vā pana māṇava, puriso asiṃ kosiyā pavāheyya,
dn10:2.24.6: ayaṃ asi ayaṃ kosi, añño asi aññā kosi, kosiyā tveva asi pabāḷho’ti.
dn10:2.24.7: seyyathāpi vā pana māṇava, puriso ahiṃ karaṇḍā uddhareyya,
dn10:2.24.9: ayaṃ ahi ayaṃ karaṇḍo, añño ahi añño karaṇḍo. karaṇḍātveva ahi ubbhato’ti.
dn10:2.24.10: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn10:2.24.11: yampi māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe …pe… aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ,
dn10:2.25.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte iddhividhāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.25.2: so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: eko’pi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti, āvībhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse. paṭhaviyā’pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti, seyyathāpi udake. udake’pi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ. ākāse’pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. ime’pi candimasuriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati. yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
dn10:2.26.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, dakkho kumbhakāro vā kumbhakārantevāsī vā suparikammakatāya mattikāya yaṃ yadeva bhājanavikatiṃ ākaṅkheyya taṃ tadeva kareyya abhinipphādeyya-
dn10:2.26.2: seyyathā vā pana māṇava, dakkho dantakāro vā dantakārantevāsī vā suparikammakatasmiṃ dantasmiṃ yaṃ yadeva dantavikatiṃ ākaṅkheyya taṃ tadeva kareyya abhinipphādeyya-
dn10:2.26.3: seyyathā vā pana māṇava, dakkho suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakārantevāsī vā suparikammakatasmiṃ suvaṇṇasmiṃ yaṃ yadeva suvaṇṇavikatiṃ ākaṅkheyya taṃ tadeva kareyya abhinipphādeyya-
dn10:2.26.4: evameva kho māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte iddhividhāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.26.5: so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: eko’pi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti. yampi māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti,
dn10:2.27.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte dibbāya sotadhātuyā cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.27.2: so dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca.
dn10:2.27.3: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso addhānamaggapaṭipanno, so suṇeyya bherisaddampi mudiṅgasaddampi saṅkhapaṇavadeṇḍimasaddampi, tassa evamassa: bherisaddo iti’pi mudiṅgasaddo iti’pi saṅkhapaṇavadeṇḍimasaddo iti’pi.
dn10:2.27.5: evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte dibbāya sotadhātuyā cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.27.6: so dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca. yampi māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe …pe… ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca,
dn10:2.28.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte cetopariyañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.28.2: so parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:

dn10:2.28.5: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.6: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.7: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.8: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.9: saṅkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṅkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.10: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.11: mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajānāti.

dn10:2.28.14: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.15: samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.16: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.17: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.28.18: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.29.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, itthī vā puriso vā daharo vā yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno sakaṇikaṃ vā sakaṇikanti jāneyya, akaṇikaṃ vā akaṇikanti jāneyya,
dn10:2.29.3: evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte cetopariyañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.29.4: so parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
dn10:2.29.5: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajānāti. vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajānāti. sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti. vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti. samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajānāti. vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajānāti. saṅkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ …pe… vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti. avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti. yampi māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe …pe…
dn10:2.29.6: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn10:2.30.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.30.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dve’pi jātiyo tisso’pi jātiyo catasso’pi jātiyo pañca’pi jātiyo dasa’pi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke’pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe ‘amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra uppādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn10:2.31.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, puriso sakamhā gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya tamhā’pi gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya. so tamhā gāmā sakaññeva gāmaṃ paccāgaccheyya, tassa evamassa: ‘ahaṃ kho sakamhā gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agacchiṃ. tatra evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. tamhāpi gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agacchiṃ. tatrāpi evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. so’mhi tamhā gāmā sakaññeva gāmaṃ paccāgato’ti.
dn10:2.31.2: evameva kho māṇava bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.31.3: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dve’pi jātiyo tisso’pi jātiyo catasso’pi jātiyo pañca’pi jātiyo dasa’pi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke’pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe ‘amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto- so tato cuto amutra uppādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. yampi māṇava, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe …pe… anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn10:2.32.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.32.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāti: ‘ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
dn10:2.33.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, majjhe siṃghāṭake pāsādo. tattha cakkhumā puriso ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante’pi rathiyā vīthisañcarante’pi majjhe siṃghāṭake nisinne’pi, tassa evamassa: ete manussā gehaṃ pavisanti. ete nikkhamanti. ete rathiyā vīthisañcaranti. ete majjhe siṃghāṭake nisinnā’ti.
dn10:2.33.3: evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

dn10:2.34.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.34.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
dn10:2.34.3: ime āsavā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
dn10:2.35.1: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
dn10:2.35.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
dn10:2.36.1: seyyathāpi māṇava, pabbatasaṅkhepe udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo, tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippisambukampi sakkharakaṭhalampi macchagumbampi carantampi tiṭṭhantampi, tassa evamassa: ayaṃ kho udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo. tatrime sippisambukā’pi sakkharakaṭhalā’pi macchagumbā’pi caranti’pi tiṭṭhanti’pīti,
dn10:2.36.3: evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn10:2.36.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ime āsavā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ
dn10:2.36.6: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā’pi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavā’pi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavā’pi cittaṃ vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti. yampi māṇava bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe …pe… kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
dn10:2.37.1: ayaṃ kho māṇava, so ariyo paññākkhandho yassa so bhagavā vaṇṇavādī ahosi, yattha ca imaṃ janataṃ samādapesi nivesesi patiṭṭhāpesi.
dn10:2.37.3: acchariyaṃ bho ānanda, abbhutaṃ bho ānanda,
dn10:2.37.4: so cāyaṃ bho ānanda, ariyo paññākkhandho paripuṇṇo. evamparipuṇṇañcāhaṃ
dn10:2.37.5: bho ānanda, ariyaṃ paññākkhandhaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu na samanupassāmi.
dn10:2.37.7: abhikkantaṃ bho ānanda, abhikkantaṃ bho ānanda,
dn10:2.37.8: seyyathāpi bho ānanda, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evameva kho bhotā ānandena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn10:2.37.9: esāhaṃ bho ānanda, bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn10:2.37.10: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ ānando dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
